d:
A divine humanoid species with a tall, imposing build and a face of absolute maturity. The hair is a voluminous mane of shimmering platinum white. The eyes are glowing with a divine light of electric gold. The attire consists of a layered white robe with ornate gold filigree and a high collar. The design features ten shimmering white wings arranged in a radial pattern on the back. 5 fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
